description.value: Kicking Horse Hostel is a budget hostel situated in Golden, BC, a mountain town that serves as a gateway to Yoho National Park, Kicking Horse Mountain Resort, and a network of world-class cycling trails. Golden sits at the confluence of several major touring routes through the Canadian Rockies, making it a natural overnight stop for long-distance cyclists. The hostel's location on Station Avenue places it within the small downtown core.
